title: Iterate the full page cookie banner examples in the review app
body:
## What
Progressively enhance the review app cookie banner example so that it hides the banner with JavaScript if user has consented to cookies and JavaScript is enabled, and reloads the page if JS isn’t enabled.  

We should add an example to the review app for when the service is only collecting essential cookies both on client and server side.

## Why 
To help us to iterate the cookie banner guidance in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-design-system/issues/1556 and add guidance and examples for the above. 

## Who needs to know about this
Developer 

## Done when
- [x] We've iterated/added the examples as above
- [x] We've added any relevant findings to https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-design-system/issues/1556
author: Participant 1
